sentences.text: Mira, an 8-year-old spayed cat, refused every Hill's z/d feeding from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row, with 34 of 38 rated feedings refused and 4 partly eaten, and the trial was stopped on day 19 of 42.
Intake not directly observed: a free-fed Purina ONE bowl was down, and what she ate from it is unknown.
Weight was −6.8% in 18 days, 4.4 kg on Jun 1 to 4.1 kg on Jun 19, from 2 home-scale readings.
Vomiting was entered on 5 of 19 logged days, with nothing logged after Jun 19, 13 days before this report.
